# PaddleOCR upstream provenance

- Upstream project: https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR
- Upstream license: Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE` is preserved in this directory)
- Imported area: selected `deploy/cpp_infer` C++ inference sources and their vendored dependencies
- Imported for TransReader: August 2026

The exact upstream commit was not preserved when this initial snapshot was imported. This is a known provenance limitation, documented here rather than replaced with an invented revision. TransReader-specific targets and host integration live in the surrounding repository and in modifications to the imported CMake project.

Future upstream refreshes must record the exact commit SHA, import date, changed paths, and a reproducible patch or comparison before merging.
